div.h1: Taylor University | Top Christian Liberal Arts University in Indiana

div.div:
Pursue academic excellence in a transformative Christ-centered community, infused with a passion to live
Life to the Full.

div.h2: What are you looking for in a college?

div.p: Jesus Christ is central to everything we do. We welcome His presence in every aspect of our lives: work, study, worship, service, and play.
99% of students are employed or in graduate school within six months of graduation. We explore big possibilities for our lives, set goals, and achieve them.
From day one, you're IN! Everyone is wholeheartedly invited to be an integral part of campus life.

This is what makes Taylor, Taylor: the strong academics, the connections you'll make that will last a lifetime, and our common goal of ministering Christ's redemptive love, grace, and truth to a world in need.
God is at work in and through us, so we approach the next four years at Taylor with excitement and energy for all that lies ahead.

div.h2: What Can You Study at Taylor University?
div.p: Taylor offers 100+ areas of study for undergraduate students, along with graduate programs and flexible online courses, certificates, licensures options, and professional programs.
With 100+ areas of study, you'll discover the academic track that's right for you. If you're undecided about your major, Taylor's Undeclared program can help.

No matter which degree you choose, you'll receive a whole-person education through our Christian liberal arts core curriculum. You'll explore seeing God's craftsmanship in every area of life, and develop as a servant-leader in your calling and career.

Taylor's growing graduate programs reflect a desire to expand and complement the strengths of undergraduate offerings. Each graduate program is unique in admissions requirements, cost, and location (on campus or online).

Providing quality Christian higher education through a flexible, self-paced online format, the Center for Digital & Extended Learning offers over 100 individual courses and graduate-level licensure, certificate, and degree programs.

button.span: Play Skip navigation Search Create 1 Avatar image Together is Better | Taylor University

div.p: Discover a vibrant Christian community at Taylor University. From meaningful residence hall traditions and chapel worship to hands-on learning in every class, Taylor is designed to help you build lasting connections and grow in your faith.
Life on campus is incredibly rich and full, with residence hall traditions, activities and clubs, athletics, and so much more.

div.h2: What's Student Life Like at Taylor?

div.p: Faith-fueled Fun
Collaborate, network, and have fun with others who share your interests, hobbies, and passions.
Traditions & Events
Traditions abound here, from the iconic Silent Night basketball game to niche residence hall capers.
Athletics
Join club sports and intramural leagues, and cheer on Taylor's 16 intercollegiate athletic teams.
Global Community
Taylor welcomes a community reflects the global Church and enriches the entire student body.
Service & Outreach
Show God’s love to our community, across the country, and around the globe.
Student Leadership
100+ leadership roles in groups and organizations are available to students.
Taylor Theatre Shakespeare’s Twelfth Night
Twelfth Night Performances take place on September 24–26 at 7:30pm and September 26 and 27 at 2:00pm in Taylor University’s Mitchell Theatre.
Welcoming Students from Around the World: International Orientation
To welcome our international and missionary kid (MK) students, the Office of Intercultural Programs organizes International Orientation (IO).
Welcoming Taylor's New Faculty Members
This fall, Taylor University welcomed 19 new faculty members.
Taylor Students Ranked Friendliest and Happiest by the Princeton Review
Taylor University has been recognized as one of the best universities in the nation by The Princeton Review in the newly released The Best 390 Colleges: 2027 Edition.
Taylor to Confer Five Honorary Doctorates
Taylor recognizes Ron Blue, Newt Crenshaw, Dee (Horne) Nesselroade, Tim Tebow, and Jen Wilkin as exceptional servant-leaders who are exemplars of faithful service in their fields and professions.

img.alt: Four students smiling in a brick-walled office, seated and standing beside desks with computers near a large window.

div.p: Business as Mission: Loving the World Well
At Taylor, we’re in the business of developing servant-leaders who will be ambassadors for Christ. Business is Taylor’s largest academic area, with over 500 students in the department.

img.alt: Students with welcome signs at Taylor

div.p: Creating a Warm Taylor Welcome
A record enrollment of 730 new students, including 681 freshmen and 49 transfer students, experienced Welcome Weekend firsthand.

img.alt: Jaynie Halterman in a Taylor uniform standing on a grassy field with trees in the background.

div.p: Running With Endurance
Taylor University cross-country runner and national champion Jaynie Halterman shares how faith, endurance, and Christ-centered community shape her identity beyond the race.
